risk_narrative:
CONFIDENTIAL

The engagement eng-20260705061527-auto-1783232127 assessed 1 asset across 6 endpoints and identified 19 security findings. The severity distribution shows 18 high‑severity issues and 1 informational finding; no critical, medium, or low findings were reported. The high‑severity findings are dominated by Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) and Broken Access Control (BAC) vulnerabilities that allow unauthorized access to the root path (/), the WebSocket endpoint (/socket.io/), and a client‑side localization file (/assets/i18n/en.json).

These high‑severity access‑control weaknesses present a significant risk to the confidentiality and integrity of the application, as they enable unauthenticated users to retrieve sensitive data or potentially execute actions beyond their privileges. Given the absence of critical findings, the immediate priority should be to implement robust authorization checks and enforce proper access‑control policies on all endpoints, particularly those identified as vulnerable. Remediation of the IDOR and BAC issues will substantially reduce the attack surface and prevent unauthorized access across the asset.
